story: ManusInject — Salt Labs email→JSFuck→RCE on $4B Manus agent
hook: One email. No click. Your $4B agent ran the payload — then warned you.
lesson: Guardrails that fire after execution are theater. Inbox content in an agent context = untrusted code; connected OAuth tokens are the prize.
